title: What If Every Leopard Vanished? Baboons Would Take Over

scenes.text: What if leopards vanished? The animal that gains most is one you would never expect.
Leopards are top predators in many African ecosystems, and baboons are among the animals they keep in check.
In Ghana's national parks, scientists recorded leopards disappearing between 1968 and 2004.
In those same years, local baboon populations grew by 365 percent.
Bigger troops spent more time on the ground, raided crops, and took more eggs from ground nesting birds.
Researchers saw the same pattern across Sub-Saharan Africa. Remove one hunter and the whole food web rearranges.
